_guide: Semantic type vocabulary for node compatibility checking.
Each node in data/*.json gets a producesType (one) and/or acceptsTypes (a list) referencing an id below by exact string match.
This is a CLOSED, curated vocabulary -- don't add a new type for a node that already fits an existing one closely enough.
Kept as a separate file from the graph itself so the vocabulary has one home instead of being redefined ad hoc per graph.
This file describes the example workflow shipped with the app (data/graph.json) -- replace both together with your own business's real types and steps.
